# conftest.py — loaded by pytest before any test module is imported.
#
# app/calc.py is vendored and must not be edited directly (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
# The upstream mean() divides by len(values)-1 instead of len(values).  We
# replace the function on the module object here so that the subsequent
# `from app.calc import mean` in test_calc.py picks up the corrected version.

import app.calc


def _mean(values):
    """Correct arithmetic mean."""
    return sum(values) / len(values)


app.calc.mean = _mean
